cell 是笛卡尔基矢按列排列的矩阵 A；分数坐标为列向量，r=A·f。长度以母: cell is the matrix A whose columns are Cartesian basis vectors. Fractional coordinates are column vectors, r=A·f. Lengths are normalized by the parent conventional-cell parameter a and have no Å unit. moment is a normalized time-odd axial vector in Cartesian coordinates, not a measured moment in μB. The operations are teaching samples, not a complete space-group list.
所有原子保持原位，作为位置和元素匹配的基准；它不施加旋转或平移。: Leave all atoms in place as the reference for matching positions and chemical species; no rotation or translation is applied.
将整个结构绕 z 轴转 90°，Na 仍落到 Na、Cl 仍落到 Cl，体现立方: Rotate the entire structure by 90° about z. Na still maps to Na and Cl to Cl, demonstrating the fourfold symmetry of the cubic structure.
将每个分数坐标 f 变成 −f，并允许相差整数晶胞平移；两套元素各自保持。: Replace each fractional coordinate f by −f, allowing integer cell translations. Each chemical sublattice is preserved.
整体平移 (0,1/2,1/2)，Na 与 Cl 两套 fcc 子晶格分别映回自: Translate the whole structure by (0,1/2,1/2). The Na and Cl fcc sublattices each map to themselves, so this is a valid face-centering translation.
整体平移 (1/2,1/2,1/2) 后几何点集重合，但 Na 与 Cl 被互换: After translation by (1/2,1/2,1/2), the geometric point set overlaps, but Na and Cl are interchanged. The chemical structure is not preserved.
保持全部 Si 位置不变，为比较其他操作提供基准；这里只核验核位置，不涉及旋量相: Leave all Si positions unchanged as the reference for other operations. Only nuclear positions are tested here, not spinor phases.
绕 z 轴转 180° 后，每个 Si 都能找到周期等价的 Si。电子自旋的同一: After a 180° rotation about z, every Si atom has a periodically equivalent Si partner. The corresponding half-turn of an electron spin carries an additional SU(2) factor, which must be calculated in the double-group derivation.
循环置换 x、y、z，相当于绕 [111] 转 120°；两个 Si 子晶格分别: Cyclically permute x, y, and z, equivalent to a 120° rotation about [111]. Both Si sublattices are individually preserved.
先将 f 取负，再加 (1/4,1/4,1/4)，等价于关于 (1/8,1/8,: Negate f, then add (1/4,1/4,1/4). This is inversion through (1/8,1/8,1/8). The two sublattices are exchanged, but both contain Si, so the operation passes.
先绕 z 转 90°，再平移 (1/4,1/4,1/4)，补偿基元的位置差。重复: First rotate 90° about z, then translate by (1/4,1/4,1/4) to compensate the basis-position difference. Four repetitions leave a translation (0,0,1). Folding back into the cell does not make the full operation the identity.
仅绕当前原点的 z 轴转 90°，部分 Si 会落到空位；缺少平移补偿，不能完整: A 90° rotation about the z axis through the current origin sends some Si atoms to empty sites. Without the compensating translation, the structure cannot be matched completely.
Ga 与 As 均保持原位，是带元素标签的位置匹配基准。: Leave Ga and As in place as the reference for matching positions with chemical labels.
绕 z 转 180° 后，Ga 映回 Ga、As 映回 As；保持的是每一种元素: After a 180° rotation about z, Ga maps to Ga and As to As. Each chemical species is preserved, not merely the unlabeled point set.
循环置换 x、y、z，对应绕 [111] 转 120°；Ga 与 As 两套子晶: Cyclically permute x, y, and z, corresponding to a 120° rotation about [111]. The Ga and As sublattices are individually preserved.
先绕 z 转 90°再作原点反演，即 S4z=−C4z。这个组合保持 Ga 与: Rotate 90° about z, then invert through the origin: S4z=−C4z. This combination preserves the Ga and As sublattices individually; it must be distinguished from a pure fourfold rotation.
整体平移 (0,1/2,1/2)，将两套 fcc 子晶格分别送回自身，因此保持: Translation by (0,1/2,1/2) maps each fcc sublattice to itself and therefore preserves the chemical structure of GaAs.
沿用 Si 的键中心反演会交换 Ga 与 As。位置集合虽重合，元素标签不保持，: The bond-centered inversion used for Si interchanges Ga and As. The position set overlaps, but the chemical labels are not preserved, so this is not a chemical symmetry of GaAs.
两个 Fe 位置和 +z 磁矩都保持不变，作为当前铁磁单畴的基准。: Leave both Fe positions and their +z moments unchanged as the reference for the selected ferromagnetic domain.
平移 (1/2,1/2,1/2) 交换两个 Fe；它们磁矩同向，因此化学位置与磁: Translation by (1/2,1/2,1/2) exchanges the two Fe atoms. Their moments are parallel, so both chemical positions and magnetic order are preserved.
反演将位置取负，但磁矩是轴矢量，det(Q)Q=I，因此 +z 磁矩不翻转；位置: Inversion negates positions, but a magnetic moment is an axial vector and det(Q)Q=I. The +z moments do not reverse; both positional and magnetic matching pass.
绕所选磁化轴 z 转 90°，保持 bcc 核位置且不改变 +z 磁矩；成立与固: A 90° rotation about the chosen magnetization axis z preserves the bcc nuclear positions and the +z moments. Its validity depends on the fixed magnetic-domain direction.
绕 x 转 180° 保持 bcc 原子位置，却把 +z 磁矩转成 −z，因此破: A 180° rotation about x preserves the bcc atomic positions but sends +z moments to −z, breaking the selected ferromagnetic domain.
C2x 先把磁矩转到 −z，时间反演再翻一次号，使其回到 +z；空间位置与磁矩同: C2x first sends the moments to −z; time reversal reverses them again to +z. Spatial positions and magnetic moments both match.
时间反演不移动原子核，却将全部 +z 磁矩翻转为 −z；它把当前畴变为相反磁畴，: Time reversal leaves the nuclei in place but sends all +z moments to −z. It maps the selected domain to the opposite magnetic domain rather than preserving its magnetic order.
cell 是笛卡尔基矢按列排列的矩阵 A；分数坐标为列向量，r=A·f。长度以母: cell is the matrix A whose columns are Cartesian basis vectors. Fractional coordinates are column vectors, r=A·f. Lengths are normalized by the parent conventional-cell parameter a and have no Å unit. moment is a normalized time-odd axial vector in Cartesian coordinates, not a measured moment in μB. The operations are teaching samples, not a complete space-group list. The three columns of this A are b1,b2,b3; fractional τ=(1/2,0,1/2) corresponds to Cartesian a1=(0,1/2,1/2).
保持非正交磁原胞中的全部原子和磁矩不变，作为所选 AF-II 单畴的比较基准。: Leave all atoms and moments in the nonorthogonal magnetic primitive cell unchanged as the reference for the chosen AF-II domain.
位置关于原点反演后，同种原子仍能周期匹配；轴矢量磁矩不因反演翻号，所以保持该理想: After inversion through the origin, atoms still match periodically with the same species. Axial-vector moments do not reverse under inversion, so this ideal magnetic order is preserved.
沿磁胞分数坐标 τ=(1/2,0,1/2) 平移，化学位置全部匹配，但两个 Ni: Translation by magnetic-cell fractional coordinates τ=(1/2,0,1/2) matches every chemical position, but exchanges the two Ni magnetic sublattices without reversing their moments. Magnetic order is not preserved.
同一平移交换反向的 Ni 子晶格，再由时间反演翻转磁矩，恢复完整匹配；这是磁序保: The same translation exchanges the oppositely aligned Ni sublattices; time reversal then reverses their moments and restores the complete match. This antitranslation is preserved by the magnetic order.
单独时间反演保持核位置，却翻转每个 Ni 上的磁矩。净磁矩为零也不表示 Θ 保持: Time reversal alone preserves nuclear positions but reverses the moment on every Ni. A zero net moment does not imply that Θ preserves the selected antiferromagnetic domain.
两个 Mn、四个 F 及所选 ±c 磁矩均保持不变，作为完整六原子模型的基准。: Leave both Mn atoms, all four F atoms, and the chosen ±c moments unchanged as the reference for the complete six-atom model.
原点反演正确置换 F 并保持 Mn 的周期位置；磁矩是轴矢量，不因反演翻号，因此: Inversion through the origin correctly permutes F and preserves the periodic Mn positions. Magnetic moments are axial vectors and do not reverse under inversion, so the magnetic order is preserved.
绕 c 轴转 180°，F 位点成对置换，Mn 位点与 z 向磁矩保持；化学与磁: A 180° rotation about c exchanges F sites in pairs and preserves the Mn sites and z-directed moments. Both chemical and magnetic matching pass.
先绕 c 转 90°再加 (1/2,1/2,1/2)，完整保持 Mn 与 F 的: Rotate 90° about c, then add (1/2,1/2,1/2). All Mn and F positions are preserved, but the two exchanged Mn moments have not reversed. Only chemical matching passes.
旋转和平移先完成 Mn 与 F 的正确置换，时间反演再把 Mn 磁矩翻号，与目标: Rotation and translation first correctly permute Mn and F. Time reversal then reverses the Mn moments to match those on the target sublattice.
纯半平移虽然交换两个 Mn，却不能完整匹配四个 F 配体；只看磁性原子会误判这个: A pure half translation exchanges the two Mn atoms but cannot match all four F ligands. Considering only magnetic atoms would misidentify this operation.
反例：Θ 加纯半平移: Counterexample: Θ plus pure half translation
在纯半平移上添加 Θ 可以翻转 Mn 磁矩，但 Θ 不移动原子核，无法修复 F: Adding Θ to the pure half translation reverses the Mn moments, but Θ does not move nuclei and cannot repair the mismatched F-ligand positions.
